description: The behavior follows Python language or runtime semantics rather than extension behavior.
message: This appears to follow Python language or runtime behavior rather than the VS Code Python extension. The Python language reference is the best starting point: https://docs.python.org/3/reference/

description: The question concerns Python's standard library.
message: This appears to concern Python's standard library rather than the VS Code Python extension. Please start with the library documentation: https://docs.python.org/3/library/

description: The behavior belongs to a third-party Python package or tool.
message: This appears to come from a third-party Python package or tool rather than the VS Code Python extension. Please check that project's documentation and issue tracker using the package and version from your environment.

description: The reported result is caused by user code rather than editor integration.
message: This appears to be behavior in the Python code itself rather than the VS Code Python extension. Please reduce it to a standalone Python example and consult the Python documentation or a general Python support forum.

description: The behavior is produced by an upstream linter or formatter.
message: This appears to be behavior defined by the configured linter or formatter. Please check that tool's rule documentation and issue tracker; if VS Code invokes it differently from the command line, provide both outputs so we can investigate the integration.
